title: wlanpi-menud complication declaration (plugins.d/<name>/complications.json)
description: Declares the complications a plugin package provides: catalog metadata and which unix user may publish them. Values never come from this file; the publisher sends complication.publish frames on local.sock. The file is root-owned and installed by a package; it grants the provider role on local.sock to publisher.user. A file that fails this schema, or names an id or node outside plugin.<directory name>, is rejected as a whole; the plugin's menu manifests still load.

user.description: The unix user that publishes these ids (root may too).

id.description: The app_id. Must be under plugin.<directory name>.

node.description: Menu node a rich surface opens when the tile is activated. Must be under plugin.<directory name>.
